thread:
lydia: quick FYI — prepping runtime v2.8.3-quant-q4a for tonight's small-window push. main changes: int4 matmul rounding fix, kernel selector tweak for small batches, and a new KV cache eviction safety flag. need release notes, a short customer-facing blurb, and a docs callout about pinning options.
marco: noted. what's the planned change window?
lydia: window 00:30–01:30 UTC. canary to 5% first 20m, then 25% next 20m. full roll after 60m if signals look clean.
deploybot: build uploaded: runtime-2.8.3-quant-q4a (sha: ab12c9). canary tag created: eng-runtime/night-310101. Canary target: 5%.
samir: adding smoke checklist: 1) tail errors for model-serving (500s) 2) p50/p95 latency delta vs baseline 3) token-per-second throughput 4) kv cache hit ratio. If p95 > baseline*1.9 or 500s > 0.4% for 5m -> abort.
ops-oncall: echo the abort criteria. also add increased OOMs or GPU ECC errors as immediate abort.
lydia: agreed. I'll put that in the release notes. docs-bot can you draft the short customer blurb and the internal migration note?
docs-bot: draft created in #docs-drafts: "Runtime v2.8.3 (quant q4a): fixes rounding in int4 matmuls which can slightly change numeric outputs for corner-case prompts. Recommend evaluation on your test prompts; if you need byte-for-byte stability, pin to runtime v2.8.2 until you validate."
jess: small nit — mention the safe flag name so SEs can toggle without rebuild: `--kv-evict-strict=false` (default true in this build).
marco: good call. include the CLI flag and the Deploy Console toggle path in the notes. Also add rollback command examples.
lydia: adding a short rollback snippet: ```# rollback to previous image
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image runtime-2.8.2 --reason "nightly canary abort"
```
samir: telemetry thresholds we will watch: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput, and small-batch matmul error counts. I created a quick dashboard: /dashboards/rt-q4a-canary.
deploybot: canary started: 5% at 00:30 UTC. pinned during canary: runtime-2.8.3-quant-q4a -> pin TTL 90m.
ops-oncall: if we hit abort condition, I want automatic unpin + rollback to be manual 2-step. no silent rollbacks for this one.
lydia: understood. manual rollback decision from oncall + eng lead.
marco: release notes checklist: internal changelog, customer blurb, CLI toggle, rollback snippet, docs migration note, release tags. assigning: me (changelog), lydia (blurb & rollback), jess (toggle docs), docs-bot (publish draft).
deploybot: canary telemetry posting every 2m to thread. first telemetry: p50=46ms, p95=122ms (+4%), 5xx=0.03%, tps -1.2% vs baseline.
marco: looks healthy so far. hold for one more telemetry slice.
lydia: if we stay green at +60m we'll proceed to 25% and schedule full roll at +120m. publishing prod release notes after 25% completes.
samir: reminder: include instructions to pin customers on Dedicated clusters (API key + cluster config) if they need to halt traffic.
jess: I'll add a small migration FAQ: "why numeric diffs? how to pin, how to test" — short bullets for support.
docs-bot: draft published and queued for review. link: https://redwood.docs/drafts/rt-2.8.3-q4a
deploybot: canary at 25% now. telemetry: p95=128ms (+6%), 5xx=0.05%, OOMs=0, kv-evict-triggered=low.
ops-oncall: still within thresholds. proceeding.
lydia: thanks all — final: if any engineer sees p95 > baseline*1.9 OR 5xx > 0.4% sustained 5m OR any ECC/GPU OOM spike -> ping thread and mark rollback. otherwise we'll finish rollout and I'll publish the customer-facing release note before tomorrow morning.
